# Pack reference

A pack is a set of models for one part of a business. Core and System are in every workspace. Each of the others stands in for a category of SaaS and is installed per workspace.

| Pack | Models | Description |
|---|---|---|
| [Core](packs/core) | [Event](models/event), [File](models/file), [Message](models/message), [Note](models/note), [Organization](models/organization), [Person](models/person), [Product](models/product), [Project](models/project), [Task](models/task), [Team](models/team) | The everyday records of a company: people, organizations, teams, projects, tasks, events, notes, messages, files and products. Included in every workspace. |
| [System](packs/system) | [Identity](models/identity), [Import run](models/import_run), [Member](models/member), [Policy](models/policy), [Share](models/share), [Tag](models/tag), [Workspace](models/workspace) | The accounts, permissions, sharing and labels every workspace has. Included in every workspace. |
| [CRM](packs/crm) | [Deal](models/deal), [Pipeline](models/pipeline) | Sales pipelines and the deals moving through them. |
| [Billing](packs/billing) | [Invoice](models/invoice), [Payment](models/payment), [Price](models/price), [Subscription](models/subscription), [Tax rate](models/tax_rate) | Prices, subscriptions, invoices, payments and tax rates. |
| [Support](packs/support) | [Ticket](models/ticket) | Support tickets; the conversation is Messages about the ticket and internal notes are Notes. |
| [Content](packs/content) | [Collection](models/collection), [Document](models/document) | Collections and Documents for a site, docs, a blog, a changelog or a help centre. |
